def retime_input_chain(tag,records,owned,logical,stages):
 assert tag in ('c','d')
 source='a'if tag=='c'else'b';macro='ac'if tag=='c'else'bd';prefix='cu'if tag=='c'else'du'
 src=stages[source]['latches']['native_graph']['slave'];dst=stages[tag]['latches']['native_graph']['master']
 sm=stages[tag]['physical_macro'];avdd=logical['avdd'][0];avss=logical['avss'][0]
 assert avdd!=avss
 def component(model,physical,first,second):
  assert first!=second
  found=[]
  for ident,card in records.items():
   if card['model']!=model or owned[ident]!=physical:continue
   ts=[x for x in card['terminals']if x['anchor']is not None]
   assert len(ts)==2,('Unexpected native two-terminal primitive',ident,ts)
   if {x['native_cluster']for x in ts}=={first,second}:
    a=next(x for x in ts if x['native_cluster']==first);b=next(x for x in ts if x['native_cluster']==second)
    found.append(dict(native_id=ident,instance=card['instance'],model=model,physical_macro=physical,parameters=card['parameters'],first=a,second=b))
  assert len(found)==1,('Ambiguous or absent native chain element',model,physical,first,second,len(found))
  return found[0]
 legs={}
 for index,(polarity,word)in enumerate([('p','positive'),('n','negative')]):
  source_cluster=src[word+'_output_native'];input_cluster=logical[prefix+polarity][0];base_cluster=dst[word+'_input_native']
  assert source_cluster==logical[source+'q'+polarity][0]
  assert len({source_cluster,input_cluster,base_cluster,avdd,avss})==5
  legs[polarity]=dict(source_collector=src['output_nodes'][index],master_base=dst['input_nodes'][index],
   source_cluster=source_cluster,filter_output_cluster=input_cluster,master_input_cluster=base_cluster,
   filter_series=component('rppd',macro,source_cluster,input_cluster),
   filter_shunt=component('rppd',macro,input_cluster,avss),
   filter_cap=component('cap_cmim',macro,source_cluster,input_cluster),
   sampler_series=component('rppd',sm,input_cluster,base_cluster),
   sampler_bias=component('rppd',sm,avdd,base_cluster))
 assert len({v['native_id']for leg in legs.values()for v in leg.values()if isinstance(v,dict)})==10
 return dict(source_stage=source,destination_stage=tag,filter_macro=macro,sampler_macro=sm,legs=legs)
